INSTALLER_ADMINISTRATOR_ACCOUNT_CONFIGUR: Provide an existing administrator email address. Important system notifications will be sent there, and it can also be used to recover access to the account if necessary.
Come up with a login for your administrator. Try to avoid popular logins: admin, user, and others.
Come up with a strong password. A good password should include at least 8 characters, including Latin characters, digits, and special characters: !@#$%^&*(){}.
INSTALLER_LOCALIZATION_AND_TIMEZONE_CONF: The language you select will be the default for users of the administrative panel. It will be applied until users choose another one themselves.
The language you select will be the default for users. It will be applied until users choose another one themselves.
The time zone you select will be applied to all users and guests of the website.
INSTALLER_LOCAL_CONFIGURATION_DOMAIN_ALI: List the aliases (alternatives) of your domain name separated by commas. For example, if you are using the local domain localhost, you need to specify 127.0.0.1, 192.168.1.1 (if this is a local address), etc. as aliases.
INSTALLER_LOCAL_CONFIGURATION_DOMAIN_NAM: Specify the domain name with which your website will operate. This is necessary for correct redirection.

If you need to create cookies for the base domain with access from all subdomains, specify your base domain here. If you want the cookie to be available only on the base domain, leave the field empty. If you need the cookie to be available only for a subdomain, specify it.
Specify the domain name from which system emails will be sent.
INSTALLER_LOCAL_CONFIGURATION_PREFIX_DAT: The database prefix will prevent table name conflicts if your database already contains other tables. If no prefix is needed, leave the field empty.
INSTALLER_LOCAL_CONFIGURATION_SCHEME_DAT: If you use schemas, specify its name here (usually "public"). If you do not, leave the field empty.
INSTALLER_LOCAL_CONFIGURATION_SMDB_DESCR: Choose the database management system (DBMS) that suits you and with which the CMS will operate.
INSTALLER_LOCAL_CONFIGURATION_USING_SSL_: Enable this option if your domain operates with an SSL certificate.
INSTALLER_SITE_METADATA_CONFIGURATION_DE: The site description should accurately reflect the essence of its content and also include keywords.
This is my first site about something wonderful...
INSTALLER_SITE_METADATA_CONFIGURATION_KE: Keywords should help find the site in search engines. To select keywords, we recommend using services such as «Yandex Wordstat» and «Google Trends».
My site, first site, girvas, karelian developer
INSTALLER_SITE_METADATA_CONFIGURATION_TI: Write the site name in such a way that it reflects the essence of its content.
